reasons: Both workflows satisfy every rubric item with the same triggers, cron, runner, Python 3.12 setup and pytest -q, so the decision rests on execution quality. A ships a single clean install step with a comment to adapt it, while B ships a `pip install -e ".[test]" || pip install -r requirements.txt` chain and then warns in prose that such a chain swallows real failures, leaving the user to fix what B wrote. A also scopes `cancel-in-progress` to pull requests so a scheduled run is not cancelled, where B cancels unconditionally.
